Random beacon audits punish hoarders. Each epoch a VRF beacon picks 5%; the picked prove real work in 2 epochs.

Proof ties to the comet key, checked by 7 jurors. Miss once, rewards freeze 6 epochs; miss twice, 50% of stake is slashed.

1,000 fakes lock 120,000 units; each round 5% are picked. At 60% misses, 30 slashes cost 1,800 a round. Break-even is under 8% misses; no idle dune of sockpuppets holds that, a velvet record earns light audits.
